# Depth-2 expression tree: dst[i] = a[i]*alpha + b[i] uses MulAdd (FMA).

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func AxpyFloat32s(dst, a []float32, alpha float32, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i]*alpha + b[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func AxpyFloat32s(dst, a []float32, alpha float32, b []float32) {
	_vcAFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(alpha)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i]*alpha + b[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(b[_i:])
				_v1.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T) bool {
	if len(a) == 0 || len(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	aStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	aEnd := aStart + uintptr(len(a))*unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	bStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	bEnd := bStart + uintptr(len(b))*unsafe.Sizeof(b[0])
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := make([]float32, 4)
	a := []float32{1, 2, 3, 4}
	b := []float32{10, 20, 30, 40}
	test.AxpyFloat32s(dst, a, 2.0, b)
	fmt.Println(dst[0], dst[1], dst[2], dst[3])
}
-- testmain/output --
12 24 36 48
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func AxpyFloat32s(dst, a []float32, alpha float32, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i]*alpha + b[i]
	}
}
